name: coolamit/ig-syntax-hiliter
description: Syntax Hiliter plugin for WordPress — dev tooling only, the plugin itself ships with no runtime PHP dependencies.

scripts-descriptions.lint: Check the v6 PHP against WordPress Coding Standards.
scripts-descriptions.fix: Auto-fix coding standards violations where phpcbf can.
scripts-descriptions.lint-files: Check specific files/directories, eg. composer run lint-files classes/class-foo.php
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the unit tier — no WordPress required.

notes: Composer is a development-only tool for this plugin. There are no runtime PHP dependencies and vendor/ is never shipped in the release zip (see .distignore).

No WordPress codebase is pulled in as a Composer dependency (eg. roots/wordpress-no-content). The plugin already lives inside a real WordPress install in the VVV sandbox, so tests/integration/bootstrap.php derives ABSPATH from the plugin's own location. Set the WP_TESTS_ABSPATH env var to point the integration tier at any other WordPress checkout (that is what CI does). This keeps composer install fast and avoids vendoring a second copy of core.
wp-phpunit/wp-phpunit supplies only the WordPress PHPUnit test library, which is what we do want vendored — VVV's own wordpress-develop checkout is stuck on 5.0-alpha and must not be used.
